title: New Hancock Whitney logo and brand debut today
主要内容: Hancock Whitney, a leading financial institution in the United States, unveiled its new brand and logo on May 1, 2018, marking a significant milestone in its 100-year history. The bank, which merged Hancock Bank and Whitney Bank in 2011, officially changed its name to Hancock Whitney Bank on May 25, 2018. The new brand reflects the shared history of both institutions, emphasizing their commitment to clients, communities, and financial stability. The logo, which features a stylized 'HW' representing the bank's five core values, symbolizes the enduring relationship between the two banks. The brand update includes new signage at headquarters, regional offices, and over 260 ATMs, with additional changes to online and mobile banking, debit and credit cards, and checks within the next 60 days. The tagline 'Your Dream. Our Mission' underscores the bank's dedication to helping clients achieve their financial goals. Hancock Whitney, part of Hancock Holding Company, operates in multiple states and has been recognized as one of America's most financially sound banks for over a century.
